cards.back:
A long, organised journey to find or learn something.
Bahasa Indonesia: ekspedisi
Example: The expedition set off to explore the caves in the mountain.
cards.say: expedition. A long, organised journey to find or learn something. The expedition set off to explore the caves in the mountain.

cards.back:
To travel around a place to find out about it.
Bahasa Indonesia: menjelajahi
Example: We love to explore the forest paths near our camp.
cards.say: explore. To travel around a place to find out about it. We love to explore the forest paths near our camp.

cards.back:
Ready to face danger or pain, even when you feel afraid.
Bahasa Indonesia: berani
Example: The brave boy went back to help his little sister.
cards.say: brave. Ready to face danger or pain, even when you feel afraid. The brave boy went back to help his little sister.

cards.back:
Willing to take risks.
Bahasa Indonesia: nekat, berani mengambil risiko
Example: The daring climber crossed the narrow rope bridge alone.
cards.say: daring. Willing to take risks. The daring climber crossed the narrow rope bridge alone.

cards.back:
Great danger.
Bahasa Indonesia: bahaya besar
Example: The sailors were in peril when the storm grew stronger.
cards.say: peril. Great danger. The sailors were in peril when the storm grew stronger.

cards.back:
To save someone from danger.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyelamatkan
Example: The lifeguard swam out to rescue the tired swimmer.
cards.say: rescue. To save someone from danger. The lifeguard swam out to rescue the tired swimmer.

cards.back:
Gold, jewels or other valuable things.
Bahasa Indonesia: harta karun
Example: The pirates buried the treasure under a tall palm tree.
cards.say: treasure. Gold, jewels or other valuable things. The pirates buried the treasure under a tall palm tree.

cards.back:
A tool with a needle that shows the direction north.
Bahasa Indonesia: kompas
Example: We used a compass to find our way through the jungle.
cards.say: compass. A tool with a needle that shows the direction north. We used a compass to find our way through the jungle.

cards.back:
The highest point of a mountain.
Bahasa Indonesia: puncak
Example: After six hours of climbing, they finally reached the summit.
cards.say: summit. The highest point of a mountain. After six hours of climbing, they finally reached the summit.

cards.back:
A path through the countryside or a forest.
Bahasa Indonesia: jalur setapak
Example: The trail was muddy after the heavy rain.
cards.say: trail. A path through the countryside or a forest. The trail was muddy after the heavy rain.

cards.back:
A deep valley with steep sides, often with a river at the bottom.
Bahasa Indonesia: ngarai
Example: A river wound its way along the bottom of the canyon.
cards.say: canyon. A deep valley with steep sides, often with a river at the bottom. A river wound its way along the bottom of the canyon.

cards.back:
A wild area where few people live.
Bahasa Indonesia: alam liar
Example: They spent a week camping in the wilderness.
cards.say: wilderness. A wild area where few people live. They spent a week camping in the wilderness.

cards.back:
To stay alive in a difficult or dangerous situation.
Bahasa Indonesia: bertahan hidup
Example: Campers must carry water to survive in the hot desert.
cards.say: survive. To stay alive in a difficult or dangerous situation. Campers must carry water to survive in the hot desert.

cards.back:
A place that protects you from weather or danger.
Bahasa Indonesia: tempat berlindung
Example: We built a shelter from branches and large leaves.
cards.say: shelter. A place that protects you from weather or danger. We built a shelter from branches and large leaves.

cards.back:
To find the way, using a map or other tools.
Bahasa Indonesia: bernavigasi
Example: She can navigate across the sea using the stars.
cards.say: navigate. To find the way, using a map or other tools. She can navigate across the sea using the stars.

cards.back:
Something that may cause harm or danger.
Bahasa Indonesia: bahaya
Example: Loose rocks are a hazard on the mountain path.
cards.say: hazard. Something that may cause harm or danger. Loose rocks are a hazard on the mountain path.

cards.back:
Left in a place and unable to leave it.
Bahasa Indonesia: terdampar
Example: The hikers were stranded on the island when the tide came in.
cards.say: stranded. Left in a place and unable to leave it. The hikers were stranded on the island when the tide came in.

cards.back:
An important job that someone is sent to do.
Bahasa Indonesia: misi
Example: Their mission was to find the lost puppy before night.
cards.say: mission. An important job that someone is sent to do. Their mission was to find the lost puppy before night.

cards.back:
A large cave.
Bahasa Indonesia: gua besar
Example: Our torches lit the walls of the cavern with a golden glow.
cards.say: cavern. A large cave. Our torches lit the walls of the cavern with a golden glow.

cards.back:
A flat boat made from logs or planks tied together.
Bahasa Indonesia: rakit
Example: The children paddled their raft down the calm river.
cards.say: raft. A flat boat made from logs or planks tied together. The children paddled their raft down the calm river.

cards.back:
The ability to do something that frightens you.
Bahasa Indonesia: keberanian
Example: It took great courage to jump from the high diving board.
cards.say: courage. The ability to do something that frightens you. It took great courage to jump from the high diving board.

cards.back:
To find or learn about something for the first time.
Bahasa Indonesia: menemukan
Example: Explorers hope to discover new plants in the deep forest.
cards.say: discover. To find or learn about something for the first time. Explorers hope to discover new plants in the deep forest.
